dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: Please... please don't talk to me! I'm worried and scared and my brain's a mess... Sorry!

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: Oh. It's Sorush's Yasnapati! Is there anything I can help you with?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the Sunyata Flowers...

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: The Sunyata Flowers have all fully recovered.

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: If you stay next to a Sunyata Flower for a while, you might just hear its song!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Sorush...

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: Actually, there's a lot of interesting stuff I can tell you about Sorush.

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: Though, I can't just whisper them to you behind her back... Ah. There will be opportunities to talk about her in the future!

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: Please come visit me more with Sorush!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sure thing. I'll see you next time!

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: Bye! I look forward to seeing you with Sorush next time!

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: *sigh* Is this... the power of darkness?

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: Such terrible strength... resistance may as well be futile...

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: Pull yourself together, Sefana! What is with all this fear and trembling?

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: Wait, do my eyes deceive me? ... It's you, Sister Sorush! You're back!

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: Ah, the Sunyata Flowers are saved... I've been waiting for so long, and hope has finally arrived!

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: You won't suddenly leave again, will you? You won't be gone for a long, long time, right? Right?

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: #Cease your fretting, Sefana. My comings and goings are of no importance. What is important is that I and my Yasnapati, {NICKNAME}, have come to make up for your failings.

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: I pursue the great task of extinguishing the Sign of Apaosha, and shall surely eliminate this dark corrosion and rescue all our flower ponds. But remember, Sefana, this was on account of your failings!

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: I... I know it's my fault...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, so Sefana calls Sorush "Sister"... But don't you think this big sister is too strict? Ugh, she's so unlovable...

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: Such immaturity! It is the duty of one senior to give pointers to their juniors. How can I speak softly to them in the face of such errors?

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: That... That's right! Sister Sorush has always taken good care of me...

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: The words Sister Sorush said before the Sunyata Flower... "I shall be Simurgh's equal"... They encouraged me more than any teachings might.

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: From that day on, I have believed that her will was most commendable.

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: That's why I decided to follow the human custom of addressing one's elders when it comes to her, to show my respect!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: What a gentle Pari you are... Paimon can't imagine Sorush getting lectured by another Pari and still calling her "Sister" after that...

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: P—Preposterous!

choices.text: Let's get back on topic, please.

response.speaker: Sefana
response.text: Right, Sister. Does your Yasnapati not understand much about the Sunyata Flowers? Perhaps I can introduce them, on behalf of the elders...

response.speaker: Sefana
response.text: There was a Pari who once sang thus—

response.speaker: Sefana
response.text: "This coalescence of color is the miraculous sign of the flowing spring of life"...

response.speaker: Sefana
response.text: "Linger here with me, dance and sing with me, let us weave lasting joy"...

response.speaker: Sefana
response.text: ...And I've forgotten the rest.

response.speaker: Sefana
response.text: I've spent too long guarding against the encroachment of this defilement. My exhaustion is clouding my mind...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't push yourself too much! It doesn't matter if you can't remember some quotations. Just say stuff in a more relaxed way!

response.speaker: Sefana
response.text: Well then, let me think... Though the Sunyata Flowers are not the most precious thing within the Vourukasha Oasis, they are exceedingly dear companions to our people.

response.speaker: Sefana
response.text: Many Pari spend time with those flowers after they've finished their work for the day.

response.speaker: Sefana
response.text: It would be like a human growing up alongside those creatures that go "Meow-meow" and "Woof-woof"...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: You mean cats and dogs?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh, so that's how it is. Y'know, if Paimon had one of those as a pet for a while, and it got sick, Paimon would be really sad too.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Never mind what might happen if it was Paimon's only friend...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon understands your urgency now, Sefana. The health of the Sunyata Flowers is definitely important!

response.speaker: Sorush
response.text: What a shallow, coarse analogy. The importance of the Sunyata Flowers is far beyond such. Your choice of words still requires some work, Sefana.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh, there's no need to be so picky, we understood what she said, anyway! Anyway, there's no time to delay. Let's go!

choices.text: Time to save some pretty flowers!

response.speaker: Sorush
response.text: Wait here, Sefana. You shall soon hear glad tidings from us.

response.speaker: Sorush
response.text: It will not be long before I shall show forth my might and free the Sunyata Flowers from the clutches of this darkness.

response.speaker: Sefana
response.text: Th—Thank you all very much!

response.speaker: Sefana
response.text: Not only have I troubled Sister Sorush, but also our great Yasnapati... and on our first meeting too... I must prepare some gifts for you in return...

choices.text: Time to save the Pari's pets!
So, as for the Sunyata Flowers...

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: *sigh* Is this... the corrosive power of the dark remnants?

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: Such terrible strength... I can't do anything against it no matter how hard I try...

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: It has been some time, Sefana.

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: Wait, do my eyes deceive me? ... It's you, Sister Sorush! You're back!

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: The Sunyata Flowers are saved... Ah, I've been waiting for so long, and hope has finally arrived!

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: You won't suddenly leave again, will you? You won't be gone for a long, long time, right? Right?

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: Don't get so worked up, Sefana! I will help you rescue the Sunyata Flowers, fret not!

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: #This is my Yasnapati, {NICKNAME}, and {M#his}{F#her} companion, Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: We have already extinguished the Sign of Apaosha, and have rescued flower ponds from dark corrosion. Leave the ponds under your charge to us.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Well, that sure was straightforward! Given what Sefana calls you, you two sure seem like you have a close relationship!

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: Close? I would not say so... though we did spend some time together and share some experiences...

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: Hmm, while I'm not sure why you're speaking a little differently, Sorush, I'll have you two know that she took great care of me in the past!

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: She said before the Sunyata Flower... "I shall be Simurgh's equal"... They encouraged me more than any teachings might.

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: From that day on, I have believed that her will was most commendable.

dialogues.speaker: Sefana
dialogues.text: That's why I decided to follow the human custom of addressing one's elders when it comes to her, to show my respect!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That sure gets Paimon thinking. Ah, she can see it now...

dialogues.speaker: Sorush
dialogues.text: St—Stop mentioning things from so long ago!

choices.text: Let's take a quick gander back to our original topic...

response.text: Hmm... The importance of the Sunyata Flowers is far beyond such. You're still not all that good at analogies, Sefana.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't worry, we got the message. Since this is a serious issue, and Sorush is being so proactive, let's get going right away!

choices.text: Time to save some pretty flowers!

response.speaker: Sorush
response.text: Just wait here for us, Sefana.

response.speaker: Sorush
response.text: #{NICKNAME} and I shall rid the Sunyata Flowers of the remaining defilement that plagues them shortly.
